versionGroups.label: The e2e projects depend on the shared @cove-extensions/e2e workspace package by wildcard: npm resolves it to the local copy, and pinning a fixed range would break workspace resolution the moment that local version bumps.

The docs site's React is Docusaurus's own and is independent of an extension UI's, which must match whatever React the Cove host page already loaded. Aligning the two would couple a Docusaurus upgrade to the host runtime and buy nothing. Scoped to website, so React drift between the root and any extension UI still fails.

@cove-extensions/renamer-ui is private and nothing declares a dependency on it (vite bundles it; it is never resolved from a registry), so it carries no version field for syncpack to compare dependents against. Scoped to the local type, so a dependent declaring a wrong range would still fail.
